item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Fighting has resumed in the Kherson region after the longest ceasefire ended, and Russian strikes killed at least 26 people in Ukraine. Russian drones hit a Ukrainian railway station, killing 13, and Russia is fitting makeshift armor of nets and rubber tires to its shadow-fleet drones while deploying decoy drones for one-way attacks up to 1,200 km. Both Ukrainian hackers and Russian actors have compromised emergency alert apps to issue fake nuclear warnings. A Russian Su‑57 fighter was destroyed by an engine fire at Akhtubinsk airfield, and Russian troops have used the Oleshky ceasefire to mask movements. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces ended a ten-day operation in Hebron, withdrawing after detaining residents and threatening a broader West Bank offensive, while the IDF killed six Hamas operatives, including two who took part in the Oct 7 attack, and a separate strike in Gaza City killed one person and wounded five. Israeli forces killed four Palestinians in Gaza and a fifth died of wounds, and they arrested six West Bank Palestinians accused of building rockets to launch at Israel. A UN rights office warned of a deepening displacement nightmare in Gaza, and a West Bank school fortified its defences against settler violence. Al Jazeera journalist was released in the occupied West Bank and Al Jazeera condemned an extension of its ban. The UCDP recorded 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israeli officials called for new strikes on Iran, and Gulf Arab states voiced concern over the war cloud. item.description:

The conflict has displaced 1.7 million people and affected an additional 173,000, according to UNHCR, and there were 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
